1. (Currently Amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced at a distance of approximately sixteen inches on center.

2. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad; and wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

11. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover that is not removable.

15. (Currently Amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements for attaching the system within the wall; and a ventilation grill. 

17. (Cancelled)  A cooling system, comprising: a housing adapted for mounting within a structure wall, and an evaporative cooling system integrated into the housing for cooling an indoor area.  

18. (Cancelled) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing is configured to be placed between wall studs spaced at a distance of approximately sixteen inches on center. 

19. (Cancelled) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing is configured to be placed within a structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF). 

20. (Cancelled) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
